panels: four full-available-profile panels: medium before/three days post, dark before/immediately post; six printed radial labels each
coordinate: horizontal y mm increases bottom/outlet to top/inlet; vertical published_segmented_signal (native epsilon metadata)

encoding.profiles: six distinct colors keyed to printed annular radial labels; all original visible segments, no smoothing or gap connection
encoding.masks: hatched gray source-legend rectangle; hidden/clipped portions absent, delayed central rise annotated
encoding.summary: all 48 requests in four family columns; dot nominal; line conservative graphical outer enclosure; zero reference
encoding.sign: teal positive, red negative, gray unresolved; text cross unsupported
encoding.dependence: two capsule histories; 48 dependent requests, not sample sizes

fidelity_ceiling: No intrinsic porosity ordering/change, permeability conversion, monotonicity, population trend or mechanism identification. Graphical enclosures are not experimental error bars and endpoints need not be jointly attainable.
